task_description: Enable Row Level Security on all 34 perfecity schema tables and create comprehensive RLS policies implementing the PERFECCITY authority model (ADMIN, DESIGNER, CONSULTANT, SYSTEM roles). Apply migration to live Supabase, save migration file to repository, create test harness, and push to GitHub.

verification.summary: All 34 tables have RLS enabled (verified via pg_tables). 151 policies created and applied. RLS regression test harness (10 tests) passes on live Supabase. Review issues addressed: (1) anon USAGE revoked, (2) snapshot UPDATE policy removed, (3) master_bom/master_bom_line DESIGNER UPDATE scoped to template ownership, (4) DESIGNER SELECT added to final_bom/final_bom_line, (5) behavioral RLS tests skipped - requires test users with specific JWT claims not creatable via MCP, (6) audit_event INSERT policy removed (service_role-only writes), (7) FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY documented as unnecessary in Supabase architecture. Corrective migration applied via apply_migration MCP tool.
